description: This is a C source file implementing background DFS (Dynamic Frequency Selection) management for a radio device, including functions for starting, stopping, handling notifications, updating configuration, and maintaining statistics related to background channel clearing procedures.

methods.name: void s_writeConfig(T_Radio * pRad,amxd_trans_t * trans)
methods.description: Writes the radio's background DFS configuration parameters into a transaction object.

methods.name: void s_writeStatistics(T_Radio * pRad,amxd_trans_t * trans)
methods.description: Writes background DFS statistics into a transaction object, specific to the radio's current type.

methods.name: void s_writeStatus(T_Radio * pRad,amxd_trans_t * trans)
methods.description: Writes the current background DFS status as a string into a transaction object.

methods.name: void s_resetStatus(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Resets the DFS status to IDLE if enabled and available, otherwise turns it OFF.

methods.name: void wld_bgdfs_notifyClearStarted(T_Radio * pRad,swl_channel_t channel,swl_bandwidth_e bandwidth,wld_bgdfsType_e type)
methods.description: Notifies that a background DFS clear operation has started on a specific channel.

methods.name: bool wld_bgdfs_isRunning(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Checks if the background DFS engine is currently active (not IDLE or OFF).

methods.name: void s_sendNotification(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Sends a notification on the bus that a DFS clear operation has completed, including result and timing.

methods.name: uint32_t wld_bgdfs_clearTimeEllapsed(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Returns the elapsed time in seconds since the background DFS clear was started.

methods.name: void wld_bgdfs_notifyClearEnded(T_Radio * pRad,wld_dfsResult_e result)
methods.description: Handles the end of a background DFS clear, updating stats, notifying, and resetting the status accordingly.

methods.name: void s_checkEnableChange(T_Radio * pRad,bool enable)
methods.description: Stops background DFS if the enable flag is cleared while it is active.

methods.name: void wld_bgdfs_setAvailable(T_Radio * pRad,bool available)
methods.description: Sets the availability flag for background DFS capability and resets status if changed.

methods.name: void wld_bgdfs_update(T_Radio * pRad,amxd_trans_t * trans)
methods.description: Updates internal configuration and status by writing relevant data to the bus.

methods.name: swl_rc_ne wld_bgdfs_startExt(T_Radio * pRad,wld_startBgdfsArgs_t * args)
methods.description: Attempts to start an external background DFS process; falls back to internal start if not implemented.
